name: Tommy Douglas
strengths: Douglas high-points contested catches and wins with catch radius over defensive backs.
Douglas shows polished stems on corners/comebacks and sells vertical before breaking down.
Douglas is willing in-line, engaging second-level defenders with competitive toughness.
Douglas accelerates after the catch on seams with smooth hip transition into space.
weaknesses: Douglas needs more functional mass to sustain in-line vs power edge/linebackers at the SEC level.
comparison: Douglas comps to Trey McBride -- 6-4 class receiving TE with body control, seam acceleration, and reliable hands (size-matched to Douglas' 6-4.5 / 235 mold).
projection: Douglas projects as develop into the TE room, earn early move-TE/package snaps, then compete for a starting Y/move role -- starter upside as a matchup receiving tight end who can also inline.
schemeFit: Douglas fits Faulkner as a flexed/move TE who wins seams and intermediate windows.
insiderNotes: Douglas high-points contested catches and wins with catch radius. Polished stems on corners/comebacks, willing inline at the second level, and accelerates after the catch on seams.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-05 from On3 Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1-2" -- not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Tommy Douglas is a 4-star TE | listed 6-4.5 / 235 | Hun School (Princeton, NJ) | Florida 2027 commit.
angle: Lead with Hun School junior ball skills and seam acceleration.
